Their products, buyers and business models differ.

T:P1.1.text: Intermex, Send Money to Latin America. Safe, secure and easy

T:P1.2.text: Unlock your first fee-free money transfer! Let's begin.

T:P1.3.text: Send money directly from your WhatsApp chat

T:P1.5.text: It’s so much more than money—it’s a connection to our loved ones, a hug, a future.

T:P2.1.text: About Us | Intermex, Send Money to Latin America. Safe, secure and easy

T:P2.2.text: Our goal is to make sure that every customer has an exceptional experience every single time

T:P2.3.text: To that end, we partner with strategic retail agents to consistently deliver outstanding personal service.

T:P2.4.text: Omnichannel means an abundance of choices.

T:P2.5.text: These days, we feature an omnichannel approach because our customers demand it. We now offer as many ways as possible to send money. Our customers can send a wire at any of our retail locations, or they can send it online by using a debit card, credit card, or ACH.

T:P2.6.text: Customers can receive money digitally into their bank accounts, load it onto a mobile wallet, cash out at an ATM, or pick it up in cash at a nearby agent location. It’s also important to note that all these funds are available in minutes.

T:P2.8.text: We continue to expand our online business for customers who prefer this option. Those remittances can be sent quickly and easily from www.intermexonline.com or from our mobile app.

T:P2.9.text: A growing network and customer base.

T:P2.10.text: Intermex just seems to continue to grow daily. We now boast multiple million customers, multiple payout locations and can wire money to multiple Latin American countries, multiple African countries, and 2 in Asia.

T:P2.11.text: Intermex is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has international offices in Puebla, Mexico and Guatemala City, Guatemala.

T:P2.12.text: Intermex launches operations in Washington and Oregon.

T:P2.13.text: The company expands and moves our headquarters to Miami.

T:P2.14.text: Now licensed in 10 states, agents starts using computers to communicate remotely.

T:P2.15.text: We expand into Texas by acquiring a key Dallas-based money order firm.

T:P2.16.text: New York investment firm Lindsay, Goldberg & Bessemer acquires a major stake in Intermex, providing capital to pursue new opportunities.

T:P2.17.text: We purchase Americana de Servicios and Maniflo, opening the door to operations in New York and California.

T:P2.18.text: Retail financial services pro, Robert Lisy, becomes Intermex President & CEO. Plans to expand into Mexico, Central, and South America..

T:P2.19.text: Intermex solidifies its positioning as a leading money transfer sender to Latin America.

T:P2.20.text: After merging with FinTech Acquisition Corp, Intermex goes public under the new name Intermex International Money Express.

T:P2.21.text: Intermex opens the market to Africa and expands to Canada allowing consumers to send money transfers to Africa and Latin America.

T:P2.22.text: La Nacional is one of the leading money transfer companies to the Dominican Republic.
